title: go-crap report
description: Schema for go-crap JSON reports (schema version 1.1.0).

summary.description: Aggregate statistics across the whole report.

average.description: Average CRAP score across all functions.

exceeded.description: Number of functions whose CRAP exceeds the threshold.

baseline_average.description: Average CRAP from the baseline report.

baseline_combined.description: Combined CRAP from the baseline report.

delta_average.description: Change in average CRAP vs baseline.

delta_combined.description: Change in combined CRAP vs baseline.

entries.description: One entry per analyzed function, sorted by CRAP score.

package.description: Go package the function belongs to.

receiver.description: Receiver type for struct methods, if any.

line.description: Line number where the function is declared.

effective_crap.description: CRAP recalculated at 0% coverage when coverage is untrusted.

mutation_score.description: killed/(killed+lived) ratio; 0 when no mutation report.

coverage_untrusted.description: True when lived mutants indicate unreliable coverage.

coverage.description: Test coverage percentage. Omitted when coverage is unavailable.

coverage_warning.description: Error/warning when coverage data is unavailable.

baseline_crap.description: CRAP value from the baseline report. Omitted when no baseline.

mutation_details.description: Survived mutant details; present only with --mutation-report --detailed.
